text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: It feels as though all sorts of people have been approaching me lately.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか最近、
いろんな人から声をかけられるのよね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
People from that big firm calling me the \"Octoking Hunter,\"
or just silently handing me business cards...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大商会の人から
『帝王ダコハンター』
って呼ばれたり、
そっと名刺を渡されたり……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
It's as though I've become a minor celebrity.
I'll have to be more careful how I act in public.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとした有名人になっちゃったわね。
外であんまり無茶なことできないわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You think it's like a reward for everything I've done?
Sometimes it feels more like the price of fame... But I see your point.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　私が頑張ってきたご褒美のようなものだって？
ご褒美というか有名税というか……
微妙なところね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: At any rate, I'd much rather have a more concrete reward.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにご褒美だったら、
もっとちゃんとしたものがいいわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: For instance, you could give me...
text_block_list.orig_text: たとえば、{0}くんから……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh! N-no, it's nothing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁあ！
　ううん、
なんでもないっ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, what's that glow approaching from the sea?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　ねぇ、
海から光が近づいてきてない？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Urnghh... It's so bright, I can't see...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んっ……
なにこれ、
眩しっ……！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Whew! I finally got some time off work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう、
やっと休みがもらえたわね！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
When you're working as a live-in holiday helper at a resort,
free time is a rarity. Though the pay's good to match.
text_block_list.orig_text:
住み込みで働きながらのリゾートバイトって、
拘束時間が長いから、
お金は稼げるんだけどね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: It's been quite a while since I've been able to kick back and relax...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
こういうのんびりした休みって久しぶり……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I know. I should find some little presents for my family.
Do you want to help me look?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ。
家族へのお土産を探さないと。
手伝ってもらえるかしら？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there are plenty of gifts of nature just lying around.
See—isn't this shell beautiful?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここなら自然のお土産がたくさん散らばってるしね。
ほら、
この貝殻、綺麗じゃない？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I doubt my older siblings would be interested,
but to the little ones, this is real treasure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大きくなった兄妹は欲しがらないけど、
小さな子たちにとっては
宝物だから。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... there aren't many shells to speak of around here, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
この辺りにはあまり良さそうな貝がないわね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Let's go and search around the rock pools.
You never know, we might find a rare beauty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
岩場の方へ行ってみましょうか。
もしかしたら珍しい貝が見つかるかもしれないし。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ohhh dear... It's tricky to get a good foothold around here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっと……
足場が悪くて歩きにくいわね、
ここ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Whoa—a crab...! Waaahh?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
カニがっ……
きゃあっ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Owwww... I think I sprained my ankle trying to avoid that crab...
I might not be able to explore these rocks any more...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いたたた。
カニを踏まないようにしたら足をくじいちゃったみたい……
岩場をこれ以上歩くのは難しいかも……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm sorry to ask this, but...
Could you have a look around for some shells in my place?
choice_data_list: I'll bring back a whole bag full!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
悪いんだけど……
代わりに貝を探してきてくれないかしら？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I-I appreciate your enthusiasm,
but I don't need quite that many!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
意気込みは嬉しいけど
そこまで数はいらないわよ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I'd rather you just choose a select few.
text_block_list.orig_text: バッグが少し重くなるくらいでいいからね？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Encouragement? A-all right. How's this...?
Go {0}! Go {0}! You can do it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
応援？
　
わ、
分かったわ。
それじゃあ……
ふれー！
　ふれー！
　頑張って！！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Umm... Was that encouraging enough for you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
これでよかったかしら？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'm counting on you, all right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
それじゃあお願いね！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
He's wandered a long way off across the rocks...
I hope he's okay.
text_block_list.orig_text:
岩場を伝ってずいぶん遠くまで行っちゃったけど、
大丈夫かしら？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Oh—he finally came back! Hey, are you all right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
戻ってきた！
　
ねぇ、大丈夫！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Huh? You spotted a really pretty shell out where the waves are rough?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　波の激しい場所に
綺麗な貝があった？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see. Well, if you were so impressed,
I don't doubt it must be beautiful...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんだ。
{0}くんが言うくらいだから、
とっても綺麗なんでしょうけど……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?! You'll go and get it?!
Wait—{0}?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？
　取ってくるって……
あっ、{0}くん！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: H-he ran off again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
行っちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I-is he really going to be all right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本当に大丈夫なの？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: He won't get washed away by the waves, will he...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 波に飲まれたりしないわよね……？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I can't stand this waiting... Please come back soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ、
焦れったいなぁ、
早く戻ってきて……！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Honestly... You took way too long!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！？
　
もおっ、
遅いじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Are you OK? You're not hurt, are you?
Wait... Hey! Your foot is bleeding—
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫なの？
　どこも怪我してない？
って、
ちょっと、
足から血が出て──

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Aaahh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあっ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I tripped over my own sprained ankle...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごめんっ、
くじいた足がもつれちゃって──

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ah... U-umm... I, ah... I'm sorry.
But you were taking so long to come back... I was worried...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ……
え、えっと。
その……
ごめんなさい。
でも、
{0}くんがいつまでも戻ってこないから、
心配で。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
More to the point, look at your foot!
Did you cut it on the sharp rocks?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことより{0}くんの足よ！
岩場で切っちゃったのかしら……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is, a scratch is still a wound!
Take it lightly, and you'll open yourself up to nasty infections!
text_block_list.orig_text:
かすり傷でも、
怪我は怪我よ！
軽く考えてたら
菌が入ったりして痛い目を見るんだからね！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Anyway, um, listen. I'm just... glad you're all right, and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
まぁ、
その。
元気そうなら、よかったけど……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: No, that's not what I wanted to say at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
そんなことを言いたかったんじゃないわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Um... Thank you for doing all this for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
頑張ってくれて、
ありがとうね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I was worried, but...
Just seeing your face again has blown all that away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配したけど……
{0}くんの元気な顔を見て、
安心したわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is this it? The pretty shell you spotted?
It certainly is beautiful... Could it be a pearl oyster?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ。
これ？
　見つけてきてくれた貝って。
とっても綺麗ね……
もしかして、
真珠貝？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh—the shell is opening, and I see something gleaming...
Ahh! It's so bright!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
貝が開いて、
中から光が……
わっ、
眩しっ！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
How was that? A little present from yours truly!
Did you have a nice dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうだった？
　
あたしからのプレゼント！
　いい『夢』見られた？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I made that dream based on your and Mifuyu's memories,
but your actions this time were interesting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
以前のあんたとミフユの記憶を元に作った『夢』なんだけど、
今のあんたはこんな行動をとるのね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I have to say,
you sure did put yourself out there!
You acted like it was no big deal, but were you really OK?
text_block_list.orig_text:
や～、それにしても{0}、
がんばってたわねー！
平気そうにしてたけど、
本当に大丈夫だった？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Did you want to see her smile that badly? I see, I see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこまでしてあの子の喜ぶ顔が見たかったのかー。
そっかー♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Once you wake up, why don't you try
to get a smile out of our Mifuyu, too?
I'm sure the results will be dazzling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
目が覚めたら、
そっちのミフユも喜ばせてあげたら？
きっと、素敵な笑顔を見せてくれるわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll keep on supporting her as her devoted student.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからも気のきく弟子として、
師匠のことを支えてあげて。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll see you around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Mnhh... Nhhh... Whatever was that strange dream...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んっ……
んー、
なんだったのかしら、
今の夢。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you had the same dream, {0}?
Wait, but that means...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
{0}くんも同じ夢を見たの？
　
ということは……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
...?! F-forget about it! Forget the whole thing this instant!
Urgh, this is so embarrassing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
！？
　わ、忘れて！
　忘れなさい今すぐっ！
うぅ、恥ずかしい……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh—that shell... It's the one you picked up
when we were searching for ingredients, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら。
その貝って、
ここで食材探しをした時に
拾ってたものよね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're giving it to me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
これを私に？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Wow... It feels like there's something inside.Could it be a pearl?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ。
これ、
中になにか入ってるわね。
これって真珠？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Really, you're such a little charmer sometimes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
弟子のくせに生意気なんだから。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you. I'll keep it as a special treasure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ありがとう。
これ、
宝物にするわね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's not like me to say that? You think so?
I mean, it's a present from you, {0}.
Of course I want to treasure it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　普段の私っぽくない？
　そうかしら。
だって、
{0}くんがくれたものだもの。
大切にしたいわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Heheh. You'll always be my number one student!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
これからもよろしくねっ♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And with those words, Mifuyu gave a beaming smile.
text_block_list.orig_text: そう言うと、幸せそうな顔で微笑むミフユだった。
